headline: Where will water come from to reclaim 100,000 hectares of desert in Bukhara region? Minister answers
summary: Uzbekistan's water minister said no additional water will be allocated to develop 100,000 hectares of desert land in Bukhara region. Officials plan to use collector and groundwater, cut canal losses and adopt drip irrigation. A Chinese company has expressed interest in the project.
why: Water availability is the main constraint on large-scale agricultural expansion in Central Asia's arid regions, which affects farm output and related investment.
